shortcodes.use_when: For e-commerce sites with shopping cart functionality
shortcodes.description: Shopping cart icon with badge showing item count. Opens side cart overlay on click. Includes full cart management UI.

shortcodes.use_when: For e-commerce sites where users can save favorite products
shortcodes.description: Wishlist/favorites icon with badge showing saved items count. Only visible for logged-in users.

shortcodes.use_when: For sites requiring user authentication and account management
shortcodes.description: User login/profile dropdown. Shows login link for guests, user avatar and dropdown menu (My Account, Orders, Wishlist, Logout) for logged-in users.

shortcodes.use_when: For sites with product search or content search functionality
shortcodes.description: Search input with live product search results dropdown. Uses vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery dependency).

shortcodes.use_when: For responsive sites requiring mobile navigation
shortcodes.description: Hamburger menu icon that opens mobile navigation drawer. Essential for responsive sites.

shortcodes.use_when: For contact pages requiring a functional form that submits to Frappe backend
shortcodes.description: Functional contact form with name, email, subject (dropdown from Contact Us Settings), and message fields. Submits via frappe.call() to send_message endpoint. Shows success/error feedback inline.

shortcodes.use_when: For displaying company contact information (address, phone, email) from Frappe settings
shortcodes.description: Displays contact information from Contact Us Settings DocType: address, phone number (with tel: link), and email (with mailto: link). Includes SVG icons that inherit currentColor.

shortcodes.use_when: For about/team pages to display team members from Frappe About Us Settings
shortcodes.description: Responsive grid of team members from About Us Settings DocType. Each member shows photo (or placeholder), name, and bio. Inherits colors from parent section.

shortcodes.use_when: For about/history pages to display company milestones from Frappe About Us Settings
shortcodes.description: Vertical timeline showing company history milestones from About Us Settings DocType. Each item has year and highlight text. Uses currentColor for styling.
